title: Galactic Odyssey
description: A crew of astronauts embarks on a mission beyond the known galaxy, only to discover a civilisation that challenges everything humanity believes about existence.

title: The Silent Storm
description: A detective investigates a series of disappearances in a remote coastal town, uncovering secrets buried for decades beneath the surface.

title: Chasing Monsoon
description: Two strangers meet during a monsoon trek across the Western Ghats and find more than just shelter from the rain.

title: Iron Fable
description: A blacksmith's apprentice discovers a mythical sword that grants power — but at a cost that threatens the entire kingdom.
